pages.title: Metric Tensor
pages.text: The object that tells you how to measure distance and time in curved spacetime: feed it two directions and it returns a number. In flat space it is simple; around stars and black holes it varies from point to point. The tensor is smooth and slightly warped when held.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Flat Minkowski geometry was not enough near massive things. I differentiated the lattice and weighted it with a neutronium plate, and the Tensor Calculus Engine returned the curved metric that described it.
